string-array.name: quick_tips
string-array.item: Never share your OTP, not even with “bank staff”.
You never need your UPI PIN to receive money.
Police never arrest anyone over a video call.
Do not install apps sent as APK files on WhatsApp.
Banks never ask for KYC updates through SMS links.
Got scammed? Call 1930 immediately.

string-array.name: wifi_tips
string-array.item: Avoid banking and UPI on public Wi-Fi (stations, cafés, hotels). Use mobile data instead.
Never enter OTPs or passwords on a page that opens by itself when you join a Wi-Fi.
Turn off auto-connect to open networks.
Forget Wi-Fi networks you no longer use.

string-array.name: tip_kyc_steps
string-array.item: Banks never ask you to update KYC through an SMS or WhatsApp link.
Do not open the link or call the number in the message.
Update KYC only at your branch or in your bank’s official app.
Never share OTP, PIN, CVV or card numbers.

string-array.name: tip_arrest_steps
string-array.item: There is no such thing as a “digital arrest” in Indian law.
Real police never question you over video call or ask for money to “clear your name”.
Hang up. Do not stay on the call because you are scared.
Report the number at 1930 or cybercrime.gov.in.

string-array.name: tip_upi_steps
string-array.item: Your UPI PIN is only for SENDING money, never for receiving it.
Decline collect requests from people you do not know.
Read the screen before entering your PIN: it says “pay”, not “receive”.
Scanning a QR code is also only for paying.

string-array.name: tip_delivery_steps
string-array.item: Track parcels only in the shopping app or the official courier website.
Do not pay small “redelivery” fees through links.
India Post and couriers do not ask for card details by SMS.
Paste the message into PhoneGuard to check it.

string-array.name: tip_screen_steps
string-array.item: Never install AnyDesk, TeamViewer QuickSupport or AirDroid because a caller asked you to.
These apps let the other person see your OTPs and control your phone.
If you already installed one, uninstall it and change your banking passwords.
Real banks never need to see your screen.

string-array.name: tip_otp_steps
string-array.item: No real bank, company or government office will ever ask for your OTP.
Read the OTP message: it tells you what the OTP is for.
If someone is pressuring you, hang up and call your bank yourself.

string-array.name: tip_helpline_steps
string-array.item: Use the number printed on your card, passbook or in the official app.
Do not trust numbers from Google search results, comments or social media.
Real customer care never asks you to install apps or share OTPs.
